data.name: Hamidah
data.gender_notes: Hamidah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is always present and supportive. The name Hamidah carries the meaning “Companion, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hamidah usually hope their child will grow to embody companion, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Hamidah is associated with Allah's presence and support.
data.etymology: Hamidah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion, Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hamidah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: حميدة
in_arabic.meaning: حميدة تعني الشخصية الحميدة والمحمودة والمثالية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حميدة مشتق من الفعل حميد والذي يعني الحمد والثناء. يعتبر اسم حميدة من الأسماء المحمودة في الإسلام والتي تعبر عن الشخصية الحميدة والمحمودة والمثالية. وقد ورد ذكر الفعل حميد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَهُوَ الْحَمِيدُ الْمَجِيدُ' (سورة الحديد: 29).

in_urdu.name: حمیدہ
in_urdu.meaning: حمیدہ کا مطلب ہے قابل ستائش، محمود، مثالی شخصیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: حمیدہ نام عربی زبان کے الفعل حميد سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حمد اور ستائش۔ اسلامی تقالید میں حمیدہ ایک محمود نام ہے جو مثالی اور قابل ستائش شخصیت کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔ قرآن کریم میں بھی حميد کا ذکر ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ حدید میں: 'وَهُوَ الْحَمِيدُ الْمَجِيدُ' (حدید: 29)۔

in_hindi.name: हमीदा
in_hindi.meaning: हमीदा का अर्थ है प्रशंसनीय, आदर्श व्यक्तित्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: हमीदा नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया हमद से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रशंसा और स्तुति। इस्लामी परंपरा में हमीदा एक प्रशंसनीय नाम है जो आदर्श और प्रशंसनीय व्यक्तित्व का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है। कुरआन में भी हमिद का उल्लेख है, जैसे कि सूरा हदीद में: 'وَهُوَ الْحَمِيدُ الْمَجِيدُ' (हदीद: 29)।

in_pashto.name: حمیده
in_pashto.meaning: حمیده د ستاینې وړ، محمود، مثالی شخصیت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حمیده نوم د عربي ژبې د حميد فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د ستاینې او حمد دی. په اسلامي دود کې حمیده يو ستاینې وړ نوم دی چې مثالی او ستاینې وړ شخصیت څرګندوي. قرآن کريم کې هم حميد يادونه شوې ده، لکه د حدید سورت کې: 'وَهُوَ الْحَمِيدُ الْمَجِيدُ' (حدید: 29).

in_english.name: Hamidah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hamidah is derived from the Arabic root 'hamida' (حَمِدَ), which means to praise or commend. In Islamic tradition, Hamidah is a name that signifies a praiseworthy and commendable personality. The root 'hamid' is mentioned in the Quran, for example, in Surah Al-Hadid: 'وَهُوَ الْحَمِيدُ الْمَجِيدُ' (Al-Hadid: 29). The name Hamidah reflects a person who is admired and respected for their good character and virtues.

Historically, it has been given to Muslim girls as a reminder to be kind, compassionate, and dependable in their relationships with others. In many Muslim communities, the name Hamidah is associated with loyalty, commitment, and dedication.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Hamidah reflects the belief that Allah (God) is Always Present and Ever-Merciful. The name serves as a constant reminder to the bearer of the name to be mindful of Allah's presence in every moment and to strive to embody His qualities of mercy, kindness, and support. It is a reminder to treat others with compassion and to offer help and comfort to those in need, just as Allah does for His creation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Companion, Supporter" symbolizes One who is always present and supportive.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Hamidah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of companion, supporter.
